points.description: States the cause/core condition: drought arising from a serious reduction in water availability, specifically a drop in ground water level (as given in the model answer).
points.partial_credit: Half if it mentions reduced water/ground water vaguely without stating excessive reduction in ground water level.

points.description: States the conditions of occurrence: usually in low rainfall areas combined with excessive use of ground water.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of low rainfall or excessive ground water usage is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the drought comes from a large fall in ground water level and occurs in low-rainfall areas with heavy ground water use. Give 1 mark if only one of these ideas is clear, or both are vague. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong definitions. Accept clear synonyms.
